creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A heavy-gravity zone that drags fliers out of the sky and slows everything caught inside
environmentalInteractions: Fliers and hover fighters inside the well are forced to the ground, where melee kits can finally reach them.
Grounded fliers also lose airborne evasion bonuses — artillery that lives on altitude fights flat-footed inside the well.
Placed over the fountain or a choke point it turns the enemy's mobility advantage into a shared crawl.
sideEffects: Affects BOTH teams — your own fliers drop and your own advance slows 20% inside it.
It cannot be destroyed; misplacing it hands the enemy 60 seconds of free positioning around a zone you created.
counterplay: Leave the radius — flight resumes and speed returns the moment a fighter crosses the 10 m boundary.
Wait out the 60-second duration and keep ranged pressure from outside the well.
Draft ground-based fighters — a team that never flies loses almost nothing inside it.
visualManifestation: A lens of warped, heat-shimmer air over darkened ground; dust and debris stream inward and downward, and airborne fighters visibly sag to earth crossing its edge.
audioManifestation: A deep sub-bass pull, like a held breath, punctuated by the thud of fliers touching down.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: anti-air control field archetype.
